011import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;

013import paint.ui.dialogs.project.ExperimentsPanel;

029/**
030 * Main dialog responsible for configuring a PAINT Project and running associated operations
031 * (TrackMate, Generate Squares, Viewer). Builds the UI, wires the controller callbacks,
032 * and coordinates worker thread execution and cancellation.
033 */
034public class ProjectDialog {
035
036    // ----- public API kept stable -----
037
038    /**
039     * Operation mode for the dialog. Determines UI content and behavior.
040     */
041    public enum DialogMode {
042        TRACKMATE_BATCH,
043        TRACKMATE_SINGLE,
044        GENERATE_SQUARES,
045        VIEWER
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * Functional callback for executing expensive computations on a fully constructed Project.
050     * Returning {@code true} indicates success; {@code false} indicates failure.
051     */
052    @FunctionalInterface
053    public interface CalculationCallback {
054        boolean run(Project project);
055    }
056
057    private final    JDialog             dialog;
058    private final    DialogMode          mode;
059    private          Path                projectPath;
060    private          CalculationCallback calculationCallback;
061    private volatile boolean             cancelled = false;
062    private volatile Thread              workerThread;
063    private final    ProjectPathsPanel   projectPathsPanel;
064    private final    SquaresParamsPanel  squaresParamsPanel;
065    private final    ExperimentsPanel    experimentsPanel;
066    private final    BottomBarPanel      bottomBarPanel;
067
068    public ProjectDialog(Frame owner, Path initialProjectPath, DialogMode dialogMode) {
069        this.mode        = dialogMode;
070        this.projectPath = initialProjectPath;
071
072        PaintConfig paintConfig = PaintConfig.instance();
073
074        final String title = getDialogTitle(dialogMode);
075
076        this.dialog = new JDialog(owner, title, false);
077        this.dialog.setDefaultCloseOperation(WindowConstants.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE);
078
079        dialog.addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
080            @Override
081            public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
082                onWindowClose();
083            }
084        });
085
086        // ---- build UI ----
087        final JPanel root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
088        final JPanel form = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
089
090        projectPathsPanel  = new ProjectPathsPanel(dialogMode, projectPath);
091        if (dialogMode == DialogMode.VIEWER || dialogMode == DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
092            squaresParamsPanel = null;
093        } else {
094            squaresParamsPanel = new SquaresParamsPanel(dialogMode);
095        }
096
097        if (squaresParamsPanel != null) {
098            form.add(projectPathsPanel.component(), BorderLayout.NORTH);
099            form.add(squaresParamsPanel.component(), BorderLayout.CENTER);
100        } else {
101            form.add(projectPathsPanel.component(), BorderLayout.NORTH);
102        }
103
104        experimentsPanel = new ExperimentsPanel(projectPath, dialogMode);
105
106        final JPanel center = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
107        center.add(experimentsPanel.component(), BorderLayout.CENTER);
108
109        bottomBarPanel = new BottomBarPanel(dialogMode, PaintRuntime.isVerbose());
110
111        root.add(form, BorderLayout.NORTH);
112        root.add(center, BorderLayout.CENTER);
113        root.add(bottomBarPanel.component(), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
114
115        dialog.setContentPane(root);
116
117        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
118        // Controller wiring (INCLUDING enableAllUi callback)
119        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
120        final ProjectDialogController controller =
121                new ProjectDialogController(
122                        dialogMode,
123                        dialog,
124                        paintConfig,
125                        this::getProjectPath,
126                        this::setProjectPath,
127                        projectPathsPanel,
128                        squaresParamsPanel,
129                        experimentsPanel,
130                        bottomBarPanel,
131                        this::startWorker,
132                        this::getWorkerThread,
133                        this::setCancelled,
134                        this::clearCancelled,
135                        this::enableAllUi
136                );
137
138        controller.init();
139
140        dialog.setMinimumSize(new Dimension(820, 600));
141        dialog.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(820, 600));
142
143        dialog.pack();
144        dialog.setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
145    }
146
147    private String getDialogTitle(DialogMode mode) {
148        final String projectName =
149                (projectPath != null && projectPath.getFileName() != null)
150                        ? projectPath.getFileName().toString()
151                        : "(none)";
152
153        String title;
154
155        switch (mode) {
156            case TRACKMATE_BATCH:
157                title = "Run TrackMate Batch on Project - '" + projectName + "'";
158                break;
159            case TRACKMATE_SINGLE:
160                title = "Run TrackMate on Selected Recording";
161                break;
162            case GENERATE_SQUARES:
163                title = "Generate Squares for Project - '" + projectName + "'";
164                break;
165            case VIEWER:
166                title = "View Recordings for Project - '" + projectName + "'";
167                break;
168            default:
169                title = "";
170        }
171        return title;
172    }
173
174    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
175    // Public API
176    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
177
178    public void setCalculationCallback(CalculationCallback calculationCallback) {
179        this.calculationCallback = calculationCallback;
180    }
181
182    /**
183     * Makes the dialog visible.
184     */
185    public void showDialog() {
186        dialog.setVisible(true);
187    }
188
189    /**
190     * @return {@code true} if the user cancelled the operation
191     */
192    public boolean isCancelled() {
193        return cancelled;
194    }
195
196    /**
197     * @return the underlying Swing dialog
198     */
199    public JDialog getDialog() {
200        return dialog;
201    }
202
203    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
204    // Build Project object from UI state
205    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
206
207    /**
208     * Builds and returns a {@link Project} instance based on current UI state,
209     * including selected experiments, path values, and persisted parameters.
210     */
211    private Project buildProject() {
212        final List<String> experimentNames = experimentsPanel.selectedExperimentNames();
213        final Path imagesPath =
214                projectPathsPanel.imagesRootText().isEmpty()
215                        ? null
216                        : Path.of(projectPathsPanel.imagesRootText());
217
218        PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialog.buildProject - project root: %s", projectPathsPanel.projectRootText());
219        PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialog.buildProject - images root : %s", projectPathsPanel.imagesRootText());
220        PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialog.buildProject - experiments : %s", experimentNames);
221
222        // persist roots
223        PaintPrefs.putString("Path", "Project Root", projectPathsPanel.projectRootText());
224        PaintPrefs.putString("Path", "Images Root",  projectPathsPanel.imagesRootText());
225
226        if (squaresParamsPanel != null) {
227            squaresParamsPanel.persistTo(mode);
228        }
229
230        return new Project(
231                projectPath,
232                imagesPath,
233                experimentNames,
234                new GenerateSquaresConfig(),
235                null
236        );
237    }
238
239    /**
240     * Starts a background worker thread, ensuring UI disable/enable and EDT-safe callbacks.
241     * This method is responsible for:
242     * <ul>
243     *     <li>Running heavy work off the EDT.</li>
244     *     <li>Handling cancellation and thread interruption.</li>
245     *     <li>Invoking success/failure runnables on the EDT.</li>
246     * </ul>
247     */
248    private void startWorker(Runnable runUiDisable,
249            Runnable runUiEnable,
250            Runnable onSuccess,
251            Runnable onFailure
252    ) {
253        PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialog.startWorker - Starting worker thread.");
254        if (calculationCallback == null) {
255            onFailure.run();
256            return;
257        }
258
259        runUiDisable.run();
260        cancelled     = false;
261
262        final Project project = buildProject();
263
264        workerThread = new Thread(() -> {
265            boolean ok = false;
266
267            try {
268                if (!cancelled && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
269                    PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialog.startWorker - Starting calculationCallback.run");
270                    ok = calculationCallback.run(project);
271                }
272            } catch (Exception ex) {
273                // Treat any exception as cancellation if the thread was interrupted
274                if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
275                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();  // preserve interrupt status
276                    cancelled = true;
277                } else {
278                    PaintLogger.errorf("Error in callback: %s", ex.getMessage());
279                }
280            }
281            
282            final boolean success = ok && !cancelled && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted();
283
284            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
285                if (cancelled) {
286                    return;
287                }
288
289                runUiEnable.run();
290                if (success) {
291                    onSuccess.run();
292                }
293                else {
294                    onFailure.run();
295                }
296            });
297
298        }, "ProjectDialog-Worker");
299
300        workerThread.start();
301    }
302
303    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
304    // UI restore function — used by controller
305    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
306
307    public void enableAllUi() {
308        projectPathsPanel.setEnabled(true, mode);
309        if (squaresParamsPanel != null) {
310            squaresParamsPanel.setEnabled(true);
311            squaresParamsPanel.setSquaresEnabled(squaresParamsPanel.isRunAfterTrackMateSelected());
312        }
313        experimentsPanel.setEnabled(true);
314        bottomBarPanel.setEnabled(true);
315    }
316
317    /**
318     * Handles window close events:
319     * - If already cancelling, ignores extra close requests.
320     * - If a worker is running, treats window close as a Cancel request (sets cancelled + interrupts worker).
321     * - If no worker is running, disposes the dialog normally.
322     */
323    private void onWindowClose() {
324
325        if (cancelled) {
326            return;
327        }
328
329        if (workerThread != null && workerThread.isAlive()) {
330            PaintLogger.infof("Window close → treating as Cancel request.");
331            cancelled = true;
332            workerThread.interrupt();
333            return;
334        }
335
336        dialog.dispose();
337    }
338
339    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
340    // Misc internal helpers
341    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
342
343    private Thread getWorkerThread() {
344        return workerThread;
345    }
346
347    /**
348     * Marks computation as cancelled.
349     */
350    private void setCancelled() {
351        cancelled = true;
352    }
353
354    /**
355     * Clears the cancellation flag.
356     */
357    private void clearCancelled() {
358        cancelled = false;
359    }
360
361    /**
362     * @return current project root path
363     */
364    private Path getProjectPath() {
365        return projectPath;
366    }
367
368    /**
369     * Sets the project path and refreshes dependent panels.
370     */
371    private void setProjectPath(Path projectPath) {
372        this.projectPath = projectPath;
373        experimentsPanel.reload(projectPath);
374        projectPathsPanel.onProjectRootChanged(projectPath);
375    }
376
377    public boolean isSweepSelected() {
378        return bottomBarPanel.isSweepSelected();
379    }
380}
